ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 2.3:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe bilateral distal amputation; right lobe displays major truncation with exposed reddish/pink pixel clusters indicating significant tissue loss; left lobe exhibits jagged terminal truncation.
other_distinctive_markers: Extreme irregular truncation of the right lobe resulting in a non-standard asymmetrical fluke geometry.
